format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
pakistan_cars <- read_csv("pakwheels_used_cars_2026_clean.csv")
```


```{r}
write_csv(pakistan_cars, "pakistan_cars.csv")
```


```{r}
clean_cars <- pakistan_cars |> 
  rename(
    price_usd = price_pkr,
    mileage = mileage_km
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    price_usd = round(price_usd * 0.0036, 0),
    mileage = round(mileage * 0.621371, 0)
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(mileage),
         !is.na(engine_cc)) |> 
  select(-mileage_flag,
         -engine_cc_flag,
         -link,
         -scraped_at)




```


```{r}
write_csv(clean_cars, "clean_cars.csv")
```
